summary: Luckin Coffee Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results via an earnings release. The filing discloses net revenues of RMB15.9 billion (up 28.5% year-over-year), GAAP operating income of RMB2.1 billion, and store count surpassing 36,000. This is a routine earnings announcement with no special-situation elements such as M&A, restructuring, or capital actions. The filing includes only operational and financial metrics, management commentary, and standard forward-looking statements, with no deal terms or unusual corporate events.
